<function=python>
<parameter=code>
print('before click, head:', end=' ')
def head_box(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.splitlines()
    rows=set(); cols=set()
    for r in range(15,40):
        for c in range(18,64):
            if a[r][c] in 'bS':
                rows.add(r); cols.add(c)
    if not rows: return None
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    return (r0,r1,c0,c1), [''.join(a[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]

print('after click, head:', head_box(current_frame))
# check if blocks changed
seg = current_frame.segmentation
blk = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in 'WPG' and n['pixels']>50]
for n in blk:
    b=n['boundary']; print('block', n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b)))
